scholarships.name: Heilbronn AI Fellowships **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: _Research Fellowships for International Postdoctoral Researchers in Artificial Intelligence._ The **Heilbronn AI Fellowship** attracts outstanding international postdoctoral researchers to Heilbronn's rapidly growing AI ecosystem. The programme supports cutting-edge AI research at institutions on the [Bildungscampus Heilbronn](https://bildungscampus.hn/en/) and across the broader innovation network. Fellows benefit from a unique environment that combines academic excellence, industry collaboration, advanced digital infrastructure, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Beyond research, the programme encourages technology transfer, real-world applications, and engagement with innovation and startup ecosystems. By connecting global talent with leading research, industry, and innovation partners, the fellowship strengthens Heilbronn's position as a leading European hub for AI research, innovation, and entrepreneurship.
scholarships.deadlineText: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and may be submitted at any time. To allow sufficient time for the review and selection process, applications should generally be submitted **at least four months before the intended start of the fellowship.**
